fit_reason: Whole pickup truck offered by a private seller.
findings: Dusty, grimy dash top and gauge cluster lens with spots and smudges
Dirty steering column and dash trim around the instrument cluster
Yellowed, hazy headlight lenses on both sides
Dull, faded blue paint on hood and fenders
Dull green tailgate paint with streaks
Hazy chrome front and rear bumpers
Dirty lower two-tone panels and rocker areas

message: Hi, we saw your F-250 listing and wanted to reach out. The dash and gauge cluster look pretty dusty in the photos, and the headlights have gone hazy and yellow. We do mobile pre-sale details, including interior cleanup and headlight restoration, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
